types.description: MKS-LDP 5/1300-1 M diode module; five pairs with common lamp-test anode

modelingNotes: No order-code substitution. S1: product sheet, pp.1-2; S2: manufacturer catalog at distributor mirror, printed p.3.9.6 (PDF5).

S1 and S2 diagrams: individual anode-to-cathode paths 2->1, 3->9, 6->8, 11->7, 10->12. Five further diodes run from the common anode node 4/5 to cathodes 1, 9, 8, 7, 12. Numeric terminal keys preserve diagram markings; descriptive roles and T-prefixed function keys are authoring labels.

Only terminals 4 and 5 have direct factory continuity. Represent this with an explicit project jumper; metadata never joins nets. Do not jumper any diode path or join the five outputs. Shared connection policy on 4 and 5 permits the internal jumper plus field wiring, not a claim about multiple conductors under a screw.

Published diode capability: 1300 V, 1 A; neither is an assigned circuit supply. No nominal_voltage, whole-module aggregate current, AC-only restriction, derating or surge rating is inferred. Catalog specifies screw terminals 4 mm2, -20 to +60 degrees C and DIN rail TH35/G32 mounting.

All passive terminal connections are application-dependent; none is universally required. No PE, shield, communication port or separate supply/return is identified by the twelve-pole specification and corresponding complete circuit diagram. DIN-rail mounting is not modeled as a bond.

The supplied circuitSymbols enumeration has no diode mark. This candidate renders each connection as a single-terminal bus with the supported terminal symbol; semiconductor direction and ten-diode topology are documented here, not drawn or simulated. It is a terminal-inventory circuit abstraction, not a complete diode schematic. No conducting bus is implied by the bus function kind.
